### REVOLVE Group Elevates Long-Term Partnership with Kendall Jenner, Expanding Role to Global Creative Director of FWRD and REVOLVE Los Angeles Ambassador


October 13, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s203.q4cdn.com/458606031/files/doc_news/REVOLVE-Group-Elevates-Long-Term-Partnership-with-Kendall-Jenner-Expanding-Role-to-Global-Creative-Director-of-FWRD-and-REVOLVE-Los-A-I0WPA.pdf)


LOS ANGELES


, Oct. 13, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- **REVOLVE Group, Inc.** today announced the expansion of its long-standing partnership with **Kendall Jenner** , elevating her role to **Global Creative Director of FWRD** and naming her a **REVOLVE Los Angeles Ambassador** .


One of fashion's most influential voices, **Jenner** has been an integral part of the **REVOLVE** ecosystem for nearly a decade. Following early collaborations with the brand, she was appointed **Creative Director of FWRD** in 2021. Since then, she has helped shape the luxury retailer's fashion authority through curated product edits, emerging designer discovery, and elevated brand storytelling.


As **Global Creative Director of FWRD** , **Jenner** will continue to guide the luxury retailer's digital creative direction across brand curation, monthly trend edits, and major marketing initiatives. In addition to this expanded role at **FWRD** , **Jenner** will now serve as a **REVOLVE Los Angeles** ambassador, extending her partnership across the **REVOLVE Group** portfolio. As a face of the brand's namesake label, **Jenner** will front key **REVOLVE Los Angeles** campaigns, appear at major brand events, and collaborate on exclusive fashion moments that bring the label's elevated aesthetic and distinctive Los Angeles point of view to life.


"Kendall has been an important part of the REVOLVE family for many years, and her influence on FWRD has helped shape the brand into one of the industry's leading luxury fashion destinations," **said Raissa Gerona, President, Brand & Partnerships at REVOLVE Group, Inc.** "As we continue to evolve both FWRD and REVOLVE Los Angeles, expanding our partnership with Kendall felt like a natural next step. She has an unmatched ability to connect with consumers through fashion, and we're excited to continue building on everything we've created together."


"I'm incredibly excited to continue this partnership with FWRD and expand my relationship with REVOLVE Los Angeles," **said Kendall Jenner** . "Over the past five years, we've built something that feels authentic to who I am and how I approach fashion. I love discovering new designers, curating pieces I genuinely wear and helping shape the creative vision behind FWRD. I'm looking forward to bringing that same energy to REVOLVE Los Angeles and continuing to create inspiring fashion moments together."


The expanded partnership comes as **FWRD** continues to build momentum, with net sales growing 14% year over year for the year-to-date period that ended in June 30, 2026, while **REVOLVE Group** continues to meaningfully expand its international presence, highlighted by strong double-digit net sales growth outside of the U.S. Together, **REVOLVE Group** and **Kendall Jenner** will continue to shape the next chapter of fashion storytelling across **FWRD** and **REVOLVE Los Angeles** , pairing **Jenner's** global influence with **REVOLVE's** growing international footprint across its portfolio.


**Media contact:**revolveus@karlaotto.com


**About REVOLVE Group, Inc.** Revolve Group, Inc. (NYSE:


RVLV ) is the next-generation fashion retailer for Millennial and Generation Z consumers. As a trusted premium lifestyle brand and a go-to online source for discovery and inspiration, REVOLVE delivers an engaging customer experience from a vast, yet curated, offering of apparel, footwear, accessories, and beauty styles. A dynamic platform connects a deeply engaged community of millions of consumers, thousands of global fashion influencers, and more than 1,600 emerging, established, and owned brands.
